title: Game Overview
description: Star Atlas brings together cinematic exploration, strategic fleet command, and browser-native progression in one premium sci-fi universe.
heroTitle: One universe. Multiple ways to enter it.
heroSummary: Star Atlas is strongest when it is framed as a layered product. Start with the browser experience, move into strategy and ownership loops, and then expand into the most cinematic gameplay surfaces.
utilityLine: Playable browser systems and marketplace access are live today. Higher-fidelity gameplay surfaces continue to expand.

sections.heading: What new visitors need to understand fast.

items.question: What is the first thing someone should do on this site?
items.answer: Launch the browser experience. It creates immediate engagement without forcing a first-time visitor to decode every system first.

items.question: Is Star Atlas one game or several separate products?
items.answer: It is one universe with multiple surfaces. The site now presents those surfaces as connected entry points rather than disconnected destinations.

items.question: Why keep the marketing shell restrained?
items.answer: Because premium means confidence. The redesign uses fewer, stronger moments so the ambition reads as deliberate instead of noisy.

finalCta.title: Enter Star Atlas with the clearest path first.
finalCta.text: Launch the browser experience now or continue into the cinematic and strategic layers with more context.
